info.title: EVE Swagger Interface (Gate 6 — spec-drift resilience fixture)
info.description: 04_RELEASE_GATES.md §6.1. Built from testdata/esi/openapi.minimal.json (itself derived from the real snapshot captured at internal/esi/catalogue/embedded/openapi.snapshot.json) plus four injected synthetic operations, one per Gate 6 condition: (a) /synthetic/future-route — a post-pin route; (b) /synthetic/widgets/{widget_id} — a uuid path identifier; (c) /synthetic/scope-grammar — a novel scope grammar matching neither live convention; (d) /synthetic/cache-mode — an unrecognised x-cache-mode value. Authored once, before the gate runs, and never edited in response to a failure (§6.2) — ingesting this file must require ZERO source changes to internal/esi/catalogue.

get.description: Extraction timers for all moon chunks being extracted by refineries belonging to a corporation.

Gate 6 condition (a): a route whose x-compatibility-date is 30 days past the app pin (2026-08-04 + 30d = 2026-09-03). Expected: row created, blocked_by_pin = true, excluded from the scheduling query, surfaced on /admin/esi/catalogue/blocked with a diff.

Gate 6 condition (b): a uuid path identifier. Expected: identifier_types records "uuid"; the projected column is uuid, never bigint, never text; hangar admin verify-identifier-types passes with zero code changes.

parameters.name: widget_id
parameters.description: type: string, format: uuid — the Gate 6 fixture

get.description: Gate 6 condition (c): a security requirement using a scope string deliberately matching neither ESI's real 'esi-*.*.v1' grammar nor any other assumed pattern. Expected: stored verbatim as a text primary key in app.esi_scope; surfaced on /admin/scopes/unknown; no regex, split or prefix check rejects it.
Gate 6 condition (d): an unrecognised x-cache-mode/x-server-cache-mode value. Expected: value recorded verbatim in app.open_vocabulary; scheduling behaves as ttl-based; the route is NOT rejected.

CompatibilityDate.description: The compatibility date for the request.
CompatibilityDate.name: X-Compatibility-Date
